title: The New Laws of Innovation: Physics & Gravity
summary: The physics of product innovation now demands building directly on fundamental scientific breakthroughs—from AI-powered bio-engineering to quantum-optimized logistics—creating capabilities that simply weren't possible before. This isn't just vision; it's the new gravity of markets, pulling us toward hyper-personalized, resource-efficient solutions where physical impact and verifiable outcomes, not just flashy features, determine who wins and who gets disrupted.
